column2: [intro]
I shop online, it's my great passion,
Little gifts that feel like a song in fashion.
A package arrives, I'm thrilled with glee,
Opening it up, it’s a joyful spree.
I wait with anticipation,
My postal parcels, a celebration,
Every day brings a fresh delight,
I can't resist, it feels so right.
Clothes, books, and keepsakes galore,
Each parcel holds pleasures I adore.
The post delivers, it's all thanks to them,
A true joy, I'm so glad I can.
I wait with anticipation,
My postal parcels, a celebration,
Every day brings a fresh delight,
I can't resist, it feels so right.
[ solo ]
The postal parcels, what a wonder,
Like Christmas in the sun, I’ll not sunder.
Treasures that make me smile with cheer,
The joy in my eyes is crystal clear.
[outro]
